svg.title: Straight optical waveguide
svg.desc: Horizontal waveguide with pale gray cladding and a blue core, matching the component library. Ports are at (16,24) and (172,24). Flat ends allow adjoining components to connect continuously. No labels, arrows, outlines or enclosing box. Native editable SVG on a transparent background, with separate cladding and core layers. Geometry is schematic and does not specify physical dimensions.
